notes.title: Update 1.1.8 - QoL
notes.content:
In this update we add a couple of quality of life features:

'R' button instantly restarts the game session. In this case current statistics will not be saved (this prevent abusing achievements).
After game there will be small game session statistics table.

notes.title: Version 0.9.0
notes.content:
Fixed disappearing skill selector controls if play tutorial before infinite mode.
  Infinite mode bonus XP for time in game and height was reintroduced.
  Disabled resolution selection greater than 1920x1200. Greater resolution causes major issues and temporarily blocked.
  Clear button unde achiements screen now clear all profile data. Including statistics, achievements, progression.
  All translations was updated and missing character was added.
  Legendary achievements no longer exist.

notes.title: Version 0.8.4
notes.content:
We are fix various issues this time:

Fix hardware cursor dissapearing,
Fix problem that cause no shield with skill "extra life"
Fix achievement related issue
Fix UI incorrect draw in some cases
Enemy shield now work again as designed


But we also add some extra features:

Swarmer damage increased by 20%
Pause screen now shows experience and level
Skills "boost" and "headstart" now grants temporary immortality
At the start of the infinite mode game player will grant 3 seconds of immortality

notes.title: 0.7.2 version goes live
notes.content:
Today we release 0.7.2 version of the game. We will update it more often now with a little bit minor list of changes. This version includes:

     Brand new COMBO system. Now you can get xp faster than ever!
     Killed enemies now explodes with debris
     We add new achievement. (Yeah. We know that one achievement for 15 level is still unachievable, but we will fix it soon)
     A number of minor and major fixes
     Updated translations
     Bossfight now slightly changed. 
     We improve the ligtning for better visuals
     Some small optimisations


We plan to release content update in few days. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update3 goes live
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26173621/780055566bf6de65533725947f169382229fc1c2.jpg

One of most important things in the update3 is challenge mode. This mode will be expanded with new levels in future. Also we add awards for this levels later.

New:

New challenge maps. Test your skill.
BOSS achievement
“Bio” location
Ingame interface for all skill including cooldown and additional info
Additional tutorial level for skills usage
Splash screen with “new skill unlocked”
Game can be restearted with “space” at defeat screen


Changed:

Major performance optimisations up to 400%
Boss now appears at 3500 height in infinite mode
Railgun cooldown increased by 11%
Skill disabled in tutorials and challenge levels
Now “Hard to learn” achievement needs 4 levels to complete
Game icon now properly draws in all cases
Enhanced lighting system. Now there is 2 light sources in scene.
Sublime level experience need to level up doubled
Tutorials now have names

notes.title: First small update
notes.content:
Hello! We are preparing a small update for the game that will add the missing ability "nova", a new achievement, and improved tutorial. At your request we will make the horizontal beam of death not so dangerous. It will not immediately kill the player if shields is active.

Also we have enabled a steam trading cards!

There is a known issue with crash on start game while 2 monitors in system is connected to different GPU (i.e. nVidia + Intel). We working to resolve it. Thank you!
